long_description: American Professional Agency Inc. (not to be confused with the American Psychological Association) has been providing professional liability insurance to mental health and social service professionals since 1978. They offer coverage for a wide range of professionals including clinical social workers, marriage and family therapists, professional counselors, psychologists, psychiatric nurses, and addiction counselors. APA Inc. offers both individual and agency/group practice policies with occurrence-based coverage. Their policies include professional liability, general liability, and license defense coverage. APA Inc. is known for competitive rates and flexible coverage options, including part-time rates and coverage for multiple licenses. They also provide specialty coverage add-ons for sex therapy, hypnotherapy, EMDR, and other modalities. The company offers student policies and new graduate programs with reduced rates for those starting their careers.
best_for: LCSWs, LMFTs, and LPCs seeking competitive rates
Clinicians with multiple licenses or specialties
not_for: Those wanting profession-specific carrier (like Trust for psychologists)

pricing.notes: Competitive rates with discounts for multiple years, claim-free history, and association memberships. Specialty endorsements available for additional modalities.

compliance.notes: Insurance provider - HIPAA not applicable. Over 45 years experience serving mental health professionals.

faqs.q: Is American Professional Agency the same as the APA?
faqs.a: No, American Professional Agency Inc. (APA Inc.) is a private insurance agency, not the American Psychological Association. They've been providing malpractice insurance to mental health professionals since 1978.

faqs.q: Does APA Inc. cover specialty modalities like EMDR or sex therapy?
faqs.a: Yes, American Professional Agency offers specialty endorsements for modalities like sex therapy, hypnotherapy, EMDR, and biofeedback for an additional premium.

faqs.q: Can I cover multiple licenses under one policy?
faqs.a: Yes, APA Inc. offers coverage for clinicians holding multiple licenses (e.g., LCSW and LMFT) under a single policy.

faqs.q: Does APA Inc. offer group practice coverage?
faqs.a: Yes, they provide entity/agency policies for group practices in addition to individual practitioner coverage. Contact them for a custom quote.

company_info.notes: American Professional Agency has specialized in mental health and social service professional liability insurance for over 45 years.
